summary: On the wall, the cannon is aimed at Eren again. Pyxis asks him to answer. Eren says he will close the hole.

segments.ja: エレンは、トロストの壁の上に横たえられます。横たえられた場所の前に、砲がもう一度向けられます。向けられる理由は、巨人の力を持つ人間は、穴の原因になり得る、です。なり得る恐怖を、兵団の兵士は昨日から持っています。持っている砲の操作は、手順としては正しいです。正しい手順の先に、ミカサとアルミンが再び立ちます。立つ二人を、壁の上の風が強く押します。押す風の中で、エレンは目を開けます。
segments.en: Eren is laid on top of the wall at Trost. In front of the place he is laid, a cannon is aimed once more. The reason it is aimed is that a human who holds a Titan's power can become the cause of a hole. The soldiers of the regiment have held that fear since yesterday. The operation of the cannon they hold is correct as a procedure. Ahead of the correct procedure, Mikasa and Armin stand again. The wind on the wall pushes hard at the two who stand. Inside the pushing wind, Eren opens his eyes.

segments.en: Beside the cannon, a soldier uses the word humanity. The meaning of using it is that if they shoot one person, many are saved. The calculation of being saved has a coldness like the year of reducing mouths. Armin does not deny the coldness it has. He changes the order. The claim he changes to is that if this one person plugs the hole, humanity's loss stops. He tells the possibility of stopping without hiding yesterday's failure. Even as he tells it, he himself admits the power was unstable.

segments.ja: ミカサは、アルミンの説明を切りません。切らない代わりに、砲口とエレンの胸のあいだに自分の肩を置きます。置く肩は、昨日の肉の盾の代わりです。代わりは、人間の体です。体一つでは砲弾を受けきれません。受けきれないと知りながら、彼女は動きません。動かない理由は、また名前を呼ばせずに撃たせない、です。させない静けさが、壁の上の兵を苛立たせます。苛立つ指が、引き金の近くにあります。
segments.en: Mikasa does not cut off Armin's explanation. In place of cutting it off, she puts her own shoulder between the cannon mouth and Eren's chest. The shoulder she puts is a substitute for yesterday's shield of flesh. The substitute is a human body. One body cannot fully receive a cannon round. Knowing she cannot fully receive it, she does not move. The reason she does not move is not to let them shoot again without a name being called. The quiet of not letting them irritates the soldiers on the wall. The irritated fingers are near the trigger.

segments.ja: ドット・ピクシスが、砲の後ろに来ます。来る司令は、撃て、を一度下げさせます。下げさせる理由は、まだ質問が終わっていない、です。終わっていない質問を、彼はエレン本人に向けます。向ける聞き方は、裁判ではありません。ありません。穴の前で、この力を何に使うか、です。かを、エレンはすぐには理解しません。理解しない目が、街の破れた門を見下ろします。見下ろす高さは、昨日まで彼が守る側にいた高さです。
segments.en: Dot Pyxis comes behind the cannon. The commander who comes has them lower the order to shoot, once. The reason he has them lower it is that the question is not finished yet. He aims the unfinished question at Eren himself. The way he asks is not a trial. It is not. In front of the hole, what will you use this power for. Eren does not understand the what at once. The eyes that do not understand look down at the town's broken gate. The height of looking down is the height where, until yesterday, he was on the side that defends.

segments.ja: 見下ろしたトロストは、半分が煙です。煙の奥に、外門の穴が黒く開いています。開いている穴から、小さい人影のような巨人がまだ歩いています。歩いている数を、ピクシスは誇張しません。しない数字でも、このまま夜を越せば内壁の負担が増えます。増える負担を、エレンは自分の失敗として受け取ります。受け取る理由は、自分が巨人だった時間に、穴は塞がらなかった、です。塞がらなかった事実が、彼の答えの材料になります。
segments.en: Trost, looked down on, is half smoke. Deep in the smoke, the hole of the outer gate stands open and black. From the hole that is open, Titans like small human shadows are still walking. Pyxis does not exaggerate the number that is walking. Even with the number not exaggerated, if they pass the night like this, the burden on the inner wall increases. Eren receives the increasing burden as his own failure. The reason he receives it is that during the time he was a Titan, the hole was not plugged. The fact that it was not plugged becomes material for his answer.

segments.en: Armin points at a large boulder inside the town. The boulder he points at is a stone whose position they have known since training. The stone they know is close in size to the hole of the outer gate. If a Titan's power can lift the close size, the gate is plugged for a time. He places the hypothesis of plugging after Eren's failure. The order he places is: even if unstable, a body that formed once can push the stone. Whether it can push is still an experiment.

segments.ja: エレンは、砲と岩と、自分の欠けた肩を一度に見ます。見る答えは、長い演説ではありません。ありません。穴を、自分の体で塞ぐ、です。塞ぐために、調査兵団の翼へ行く、という三年の希望も残しています。残している希望を、彼は今日は後に置きます。置く先は、トロストの門です。門を閉じることが、母の日の誓いの、初めての具体です。具体は、すべての巨人を消すことより小さいです。小さい答えが、壁の上では十分に聞こえます。
segments.en: Eren looks at once at the cannon, the boulder, and his own missing shoulder. The answer he looks at is not a long speech. It is not. It is: plug the hole with my own body. He also still has the three-year hope of going to the Survey Corps wings in order to plug it. He places the hope he still has behind him today. The place he places it is Trost's gate. Closing the gate is the first concrete form of the vow from his mother's day. The concrete form is smaller than erasing every Titan. The small answer is loud enough on the wall.

segments.en: Pyxis does not treat the answer as an order. The reason he does not treat it is that there is meaning in the person himself having answered. He tells that meaning shortly to the cannon soldiers. The content he tells is: we do not shoot now. The decision not to shoot is not the completion of trust. It is not. It is a temporary decision to permit an experiment. During the temporary decision, Eren is still close to a prisoner. Even in the close position, his words went through. The words that went through are the title of this episode.

segments.en: When permission is given, Armin makes a diagram of the distance between the boulder and the hole. The diagram he makes is larger than yesterday's diagram of the depot. The larger diagram needs soldiers to pull the Titans' attention away, and one body to push the boulder. The one body that is needed is Eren. He writes small, at the edge of the diagram, the memory that Eren failed. The smallness of the writing is not optimism. It is not. It is a plan that does not hide the failure. Mikasa looks at the plan together with Eren's strength. The strength she looks at is still the remainder of the heat.
